de: Erkunden Sie das Naturschutzgebiet Frost Folly, das besonders im Juni und Juli wegen der Wildblumenwiesen herrlich ist.
Buchen Sie Tische in den beliebten ländlichen Pubs wie 'The Cricketers' unbedingt im Voraus, da diese am Wochenende sehr voll sind.
Bringen Sie wasserfeste Wanderschuhe mit; der Lehmboden in Berkshire wird nach Regen extrem matschig.
Besuchen Sie das Moss End Garden Village für eine entspannte Atmosphäre mit unabhängigen kleinen Läden.
Besichtigen Sie die Kirche St. Michael the Archangel, die aus dem 11. Jahrhundert stammt und sehr fotogen ist.
hu: Járd be a Frost Folly természetvédelmi területet, amely júniusban és júliusban a legszebb a vadvirágos rétek miatt.
Foglald le az asztalt előre a népszerű falusi pubokban (mint a The Cricketers), mert hétvégén hamar megtelnek.
Hozz magaddal vízálló túrabakancsot, mert a környék agyagos talaja eső után nagyon sárossá válik.
Keresd fel a Moss End Garden Village-t, ahol hangulatos kisboltokat és egy kiváló kávépörkölőt is találsz.
Nézd meg a Szent Mihály arkangyal templomot, amely 11. századi alapjaival igazi történelmi ékszerdoboz.
ro: Explorați rezervația naturală Frost Folly, care este superbă în iunie și iulie datorită pajiștilor cu flori sălbatice.
Rezervați din timp masa la pub-urile rurale populare, precum „The Cricketers”, deoarece se aglomerează rapid în weekend.
Aduceți încălțăminte de munte impermeabilă; solul argilos din Berkshire devine foarte noroios după ploaie.
Vizitați Moss End Garden Village pentru o experiență de shopping relaxată în magazine independente cochete.
Vizitați biserica St Michael the Archangel, o clădire istorică din secolul al XI-lea cu o atmosferă atemporală.
en: Explore Frost Folly Nature Reserve, which is particularly stunning in June and July when wildflower meadows are in bloom.
Book pub tables at 'The Cricketers' or 'The Plough & Harrow' in advance, as they are very popular on weekends.
Wear waterproof boots for countryside walks; the local clay soil becomes extremely muddy during winter and spring.
Visit Moss End Garden Village for independent boutiques, an antique centre, and a specialty coffee roastery.
Visit the Grade II* listed St Michael the Archangel Church for its peaceful churchyard and 11th-century history.
